name: NLWF Revolution: One Year Show

date.source: the show's own header ('January 18th 2010. Live from the Sin City Arena, Las Vegas NV')

matches.finish: Carmine Vestieri won with a spinning heel kick, a capoeira kick and a Lion's Bite DDT, and tried to sacrifice Ashtyn Sky afterward until Frank Hart made the save.
Steven Angel won by pinfall and moved on to the final.
Frank Hart won by pinfall and moved on to the final.

matches.title: nlwf-2009-undisputed
matches.finish: Jason Hawk pinned the champion The Notorious K.I.D after a shooting star swanton while Steven Angel and the champion lay out after hitting each other with a baton and a pipe, and took the title.

notes: The tag title match billed in the card header was not held: the champions could not compete and Ryan Apollo was named champion; the three Dream Championship and Undisputed Championship matches are structured above.
